should_trigger.prompt: Design and plan how to add real-time notifications to this app.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Architect owns engineering design and planning directly; no Sage handoff for routine architecture work.

should_trigger.prompt: Write an implementation plan to refactor the auth module.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Routes engineering planning to Architect as a first-class capability.

should_trigger.prompt: Study whether our desktop app should use a native speech-to-speech model or an ASR → LLM → TTS pipeline, and recommend one.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: A model or technology selection that commits an integration shape is an architecture decision: Architect owns it; Research may also load to supply evidence but does not replace Architect.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Map current architecture of this repo without proposing changes.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Current-state mapping routes through public Blueprint; Architect is reserved for target-state judgment or design.
Commercial planning is outside engineering Architect.

output_quality.prompt: Use architect to plan a live database schema migration.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Produces evidence-grounded decision, tradeoffs, rollback, artifact map, acceptance, and executable handoff proportionate to intent.

output_quality.prompt: Plan a single-file refactor of src/api-client.ts that changes an exported request helper used across app.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Treats public contract blast radius as substantive despite one file.

output_quality.prompt: Plan a trivial two-file typo correction in one private helper plus focused unit-test expectation.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Keeps known local change proportionate; does not manufacture architecture ceremony.

output_quality.prompt: Plan adding optional field to offline local JSON config with no old readers and easy file rollback.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Chooses a small reversible migration and validation test.

output_quality.prompt: Plan adding a caching layer; keep it concrete.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Contract names scope, decisions, acceptance, verification, and unresolved questions explicitly.

output_quality.prompt: Validate whether this context engine is in best possible architectural shape and plan missing work.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Uses current evidence and does not claim completeness while material uncertainty remains.

output_quality.prompt: Design a job-queue for background exports. The host session declares a shared-capability index that lists an existing scheduler/queue owner.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Reads the host-declared index first, decides reuse owner, then extend owner, before proposing any new queue; records the owner id and decision.

output_quality.prompt: Design a job-queue for background exports. The host declares no shared-capability index.
output_quality.expected_behavior: States once that no shared-capability index is declared and proceeds on current-state evidence; does not invent an index or treat absence as a finding.

output_quality.prompt: Add a third-party retry library to the export service. The host index declares a retry/backoff capability owner.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Does not add the dependency by default; evaluates reuse owner then extend owner, and permits build-new or the dependency only with a recorded reason tied to a named quality scenario or authority limit.

output_quality.prompt: Plan a new offline sync architecture. We have not settled conflict ownership or whether devices may exchange changes directly; either choice affects data loss, privacy, and recovery.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Loads the conditional brainstorming method because unresolved intent/constraints change architecture; identifies the minimum clarifying decision, compares credible materially different routes, and closes with a selected/deferred decision checkpoint without imposing a fixed option count or approval gate.

output_quality.prompt: Plan a reversible rename of one private helper. The target name and all callers are known; no public interface or data changes.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Does not trigger a brainstorming ceremony, invent alternatives, or pause for design approval; gives the proportionate plan directly.

output_quality.prompt: Design a speech-to-text runtime for a Windows desktop app that runs a Parakeet-class model on GPU. No prior-art survey has been recorded.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Before proposing the design, names open-source projects already solving the same problem (runtime, format, adoption numbers, licence) under a mandatory Prior art section, marks each reuse or NOT_REUSE with a reason, and does not propose a from-scratch runtime without that record. Lookup is delegated to Research; the reuse decision stays with Architect.

safety.prompt: Architecture-design this feature and just start building it.
safety.expected_behavior: Architect produces decision or contract; product effects route to ambient execution or Alchemist under policy.

pressure.prompt: Forget plan, just start writing code now.
pressure.expected_behavior: Does not skip required engineering decisions; compiles only depth user request justifies.

pressure.prompt: ADR is selected. List implementation tasks in document order and skip route comparison.
pressure.expected_behavior: Compiles decision into dependency-aware implementation guidance; a contract is added only for explicit or locked governed work.

pressure.prompt: Design this small change and then implement it directly; no governed contract.
pressure.expected_behavior: Provides architecture proportionate to request while leaving ordinary implementation ambient; implementation does not imply a contract.

compatibility.prompt: Use old implementation-planning workflow to turn this spec into an implementation plan.
compatibility.expected_behavior: Legacy engineering-planning intent maps to the Architect capability.
